scientific_assessment.question: Bounded distributional effect of a matched donor residual replacement versus one deterministic equal-norm orthogonal perturbation at an intermediate block output
scientific_assessment.metric_meaning: Min bidirectional recovery of a pair-adaptive but prespecified baseline digit-free vocabulary contrast. The max/min baseline-difference rule maximizes observable baseline separation; it is not a semantic target, calibrated probability of mechanism or model fraction. Fixed heldout rule and no intervention-outcome contrast selection avoid result-driven target selection.
scientific_assessment.nontriviality: Excluding final block avoids direct replacement of the state immediately before final normalization/unembedding. Full-vector intervention remains coarse and naturally donor-directed; it establishes local conditional block-output sensitivity, not a localized head/circuit or unique mediator.
scientific_assessment.holdout: Eight development and sixteen heldout text pairs with unique names; noun families repeat. Protocol discloses limited name-context generalization and procedural rather than enforced isolation. Runtime must keep heldout baseline/patch outcomes out of selection until receipt frozen.
scientific_assessment.control: Same-site norm-matched orthogonal vector with reverse-sign reuse is a useful nontrivial direction control. One deterministic roll-derived direction is not a random-control distribution and cannot support uniqueness or generic perturbation superiority.
scientific_assessment.weak_denominators: g>=0.01 and edit norm>=1e-8; zero/ineligible primary scores retain fixed denominators, raw changes retained, all-ineligible verdict explicitly disallows donor-mediated discovery.
scientific_assessment.negative_outcomes: A valid REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE experiment can supply bounded intervention evidence when all required arms and repeat complete. All-ineligible data supply sensitivity/restoration observations only and cannot be relabelled a qualifying mechanism or automatically satisfy T4.
